about_p1: Svampskogen is a specialty store for anyone who loves nature and the world of mushrooms, located in Mitt Möllan in Malmö. I'm Kristian Berg, and I want to create a place where both seasoned foragers and curious beginners feel at home.
about_p2: You'll find everything from foraging knives, baskets, and growing kits to outdoor gear like firesteels, campfire cups, and grill accessories. I also exhibit art by local artists inspired by nature and mushrooms.
about_p3: Whether you're looking for a gift, a new hobby, or quality gear, you're welcome to come in!
suppliers_p1: I'm actively looking to collaborate with Scandinavian producers, makers, and artists whose products and work fit the profile of Svampskogen. I'm happy to get in touch!

returns_intro: This page covers your right of withdrawal, how to make a complaint, and the terms that apply to a purchase from Svampskogen.
returns_withdrawal_p1: Under Swedish law (distansavtalslagen), you have the right to cancel your purchase within 14 days without giving any reason.
returns_withdrawal_p2: The withdrawal period expires 14 days after the day you (or someone you've designated) took possession of the goods, for example by collecting them from a pickup point. If an order contains several items delivered separately, the period is counted from the day you received the last item.
returns_withdrawal_p3: The right of withdrawal does not apply to goods made to your specifications or clearly personalized, such as custom-made products.
returns_how_heading: How to exercise your right of withdrawal
returns_how_p1: The easiest way to cancel a purchase is the Cancel your purchase here link. Fill in your details and confirm, and you'll get an email showing when we received your message. You can also tell us another way before the withdrawal period expires, for example by emailing retur@svampskogen.com or using the withdrawal form below. A clear statement is enough.
returns_how_p2: Send the item back without undue delay, and no later than 14 days after telling us you're cancelling. The address is {{address}}. You pay for the return shipping. You can also drop the item off at the shop on Claesgatan 8 in Malmö during our opening hours.
returns_how_p3: We'll refund what you paid, including the standard shipping cost, within 14 days of receiving your message that you're cancelling. We may hold the refund until we've received the item back or you've shown that it has been sent. Refunds are made using the same payment method you used for the purchase. If the item's value has decreased because it was handled more than necessary to establish its nature, properties, and function, we may deduct the corresponding decrease in value.

returns_complaint_p1: If an item is faulty, Swedish consumer law (konsumentköplagen) gives you the right to file a complaint within three years of purchase. Contact us at retur@svampskogen.com as soon as possible after noticing the fault and describe what's wrong.
returns_complaint_p2: If your complaint is approved, you're entitled to a repair, replacement, price reduction, or to cancel the purchase, plus reimbursement of return shipping. We'll respond within a reasonable time of receiving your complaint.
returns_purchase_p1: Payment is made by card, Swish, or Klarna through our payment provider Stripe. The amount is charged once your order is approved.
returns_purchase_p2: We deliver with DHL to addresses in Sweden. We ship your order within 4 working days, and delivery then normally takes 1–3 working days. The shipping cost is shown before you complete your purchase. You can also pick up your order free of charge at the store on Claesgatan 8 in Malmö. We'll email you when it's ready to pick up.
returns_purchase_p3: Your purchase becomes binding once you've completed the order and payment has been approved, confirmed by an order confirmation sent to your email. We reserve the right for items to sell out and for errors in pricing or product information.
returns_dispute_heading: If we can't resolve a dispute
returns_dispute_p1: If we can't resolve a dispute between us, you can turn to the National Board for Consumer Disputes (Allmänna reklamationsnämnden, ARN), Box 174, 101 23 Stockholm.

privacy_intro: This page describes what personal data we process when you visit svampskogen.com or buy from us, why we do it, and what rights you have.
privacy_controller_p1: Svampstugan AB (Svampskogen), org.nr 559583-9159, Claesgatan 8, 214 26 Malmö, is the data controller. If you have questions, contact us at kristian@svampskogen.com.
privacy_data_p1: When you buy from us: your name, email address, delivery address, what you bought, the amount, and the payment method. Card details and similar payment details are handled by Stripe and never reach us.
privacy_data_p2: When you cancel a purchase or contact us: your name, email address, and what you write to us.
privacy_data_p3: When you visit the website: your IP address is processed for technical reasons by our hosting providers. It is also used briefly to limit misuse of the form for cancelling purchases.
privacy_data_p4: When you sign up for a course or tour: sign-up happens through Google Forms, and we use the details you give there to arrange the course or tour.
privacy_purpose_p1: To receive, pack, and deliver your order and take payment. This is necessary to carry out your purchase.
privacy_purpose_p2: To keep our accounts. This is a legal obligation.
privacy_purpose_p3: To handle cancellations, returns, and complaints and to answer questions. This is necessary to carry out your purchase and to meet our obligations under consumer law.
privacy_purpose_p4: To protect the website from misuse. This is based on our legitimate interest in a secure service.
privacy_recipients_p1: Within our business, only those who pack and handle orders see your details, and only as far as needed.
privacy_recipients_p2: We also use suppliers: Stripe (payment), DHL (delivery), Resend (confirmations when you cancel a purchase), Bokio (bookkeeping), Cloudflare and GitHub (running the website), Porkbun and our email provider (email), and Google (course sign-ups). We never sell your data.
privacy_transfers_p1: Some suppliers, including Resend, Stripe, and Cloudflare, may process data in the United States. These transfers are protected by the EU standard contractual clauses or by the EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework.
privacy_retention_heading: How long we keep your data
privacy_retention_p1: Receipts and other accounting records are kept for seven years, as required by Swedish accounting law.
privacy_retention_p2: Emails and messages about cancellations, returns, and complaints are kept for about three years after the purchase, because you can make a complaint about an item during that time. After that we delete them. Other emails are kept for as long as they're needed to handle your question.
privacy_storage_p1: We use no cookies for analytics or marketing. Your cart and language choice are saved in your browser's local storage (localStorage) so that the website works. This data stays in your browser and you can clear it there.
privacy_rights_p1: You have the right to know what data we hold about you, to have errors corrected, and to ask for data to be deleted or its processing restricted. In some cases you can also object to the processing or get your data in a form you can move elsewhere. We can't delete data that the law requires us to keep. Contact us at kristian@svampskogen.com.
privacy_rights_p2: If you're unhappy with how we process your data, you can complain to the Swedish Authority for Privacy Protection (IMY), imy.se.
